title: MashPlayerRespects
description: A plugin that allows players to respect each other in-game.
body:
> # 💖MashRespects👑 - Plugin Summary

- MashRespects is a social interaction plugin that implements a /respect system, allowing players to give "respect points" to one another, fostering community appreciation and tracking a public measure of player standing


> Features:
- Players can use a command (/respect <player>) to grant a single point of respect to another player
- Players can view a public leaderboard (via /respectstop) showing the players with the highest respect counts
- Players are limited to one respect per target, encouraging thoughtful usage.
- Players receive instant messages when they give respect and when they receive respect, showing the updated total count.
- The plugin supports sending a formatted message to a Discord channel every time respect is given, enhancing community visibility (if enabled).
- Every message, including the prefix, no-permission messages, and leaderboard format, is fully customizable.
- Players are explicitly prevented from giving respect to themselves
- Players can check their own respect count or anyone elses.

![Start with 0 respects and gain others respect to become the respected guy in town!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25a253234170f3d8ba8128407096496c681034d9.png)
